questions.stem: A patient presents with a foreign body (chuna) in the eye and complaints of irritability and lacrimation. What is the first step in management for this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Antibiotic eye drops B) Ascorbic eye drops C) Irrigation of the eye with normal saline D) Steroids

options.label: C
options.text: Irrigation of the eye with normal saline
